AGENTS.md:3 heads this requirement 'Serena Init (BLOCKING)', and .claude/rules/lsp-first.md:83 confirms that only the LSP-first navigation preference is advisory while initialization stays blocking. Two earlier revisions of this log recorded the level as SHOULD and justified the omission on the grounds that no symbol-level navigation was performed. workLog.action: Measured the two size gates against real pull request data rather than accepting or rejecting them on principle
workLog.result: 104 of 292 pull requests in 14 days carry needs-split (36%); 20 needed the human-only commit-limit-bypass label. Sampling found the gate fires on three unrelated conditions: genuine sprawl (#4846, 235 commits, never merged), review rigor (#4718, 109 commits, six defects each with fix and test, merged), and pure process churn (#5103 and #5107, zero open review threads, count inflated by the QA and session evidence rebind refiring on every main merge).

workLog.action: Tested three successive designs against a six-role adversarial panel
workLog.result: A three-tier approval model was rejected 4 block to 2 disagree-and-commit for protecting governance prose while leaving the enforcement code writable. A convergence-metric replacement was dropped after three reviewers independently argued it changed no outcome on the sample, had no baseline, and had forgeable inputs. The surviving shape is a split: pure subtraction in ADR-098, the plane invariant in ADR-099.

workLog.action: Verified every reviewer claim against primary sources before acting on it
workLog.result: Confirmed: no CI enforcement of the debate mandate across 60 workflow files; BLOCK_THRESHOLD = 50 in detect_scope_explosion.py with the code comment '50 is allowed; 51+ blocks'; required_approving_review_count is 0 in the ruleset baseline; CODEOWNERS covers five review-prompt globs and not itself; check_ruleset_params_drift.py iterates baseline keys only; bypass_actors is never fetched anywhere in scripts/; skip: merge sits at lefthook.yml:198-199 in the current tree, having moved from 199-200 when the base merge landed. Corrected two claims that did not survive checking: ADR-021 does not mandate cross-vendor panels, and Phase 0 was not blocked by a 403 because the ruleset baseline is committed in-tree.

workLog.action: Found and recorded that the control plane is reachable from the tree
workLog.result: BOT_PAT requires classic repo scope by the dependabot workflow's own error text, is spent on gh pr review --approve, is referenced by seven workflows, and the repository has exactly one environment-gated job (publish.yml:81). Same-repository pull request runs receive secrets and the loop authors same-repository branches, so a pull request can read the token and act with its account's authority; review narrowed this to token theft plus approval minting, since ruleset mutation requires admin and the bot collaborator holds write. This falsified the plane model's own premise and became the first hardening prerequisite in ADR-099.

workLog.action: Caught a tightening hiding inside a subtraction
workLog.result: An earlier ADR-098 draft described the scope check as advisory and removed SKIP_SCOPE_CHECK on that basis. Two reviewers independently found it blocks at 51 files, so the removal would have left a blocking gate with no relief at all. Fixed by demoting BLOCK_THRESHOLD as an explicit decision item ordered before the flag removal, in the decision text, the implementation order, and the impact table.

workLog.action: Searched this repository's own session logs, QA reports, and retrospectives for what the commit ceiling made authors do, after six rounds of review had accepted that no such evidence existed
workLog.result: Eight recorded workarounds across seven months, none reachable by any GitHub query. PR #5178 was squashed twice, at 23 and at 33 commits ahead, force-pushed, and eleven commit SHAs its QA report cites became unreachable. PR #4954 merged main through gh pr update-branch for the sole purpose of supplying contains_main_merge evidence and relieving the ceiling to 40, which then forced a rebind of three QA reports; at round 15 the same pull request left two live review findings unfixed because it sat at 39 of 40. Session 3468 moved work to a new branch when the ceiling refused a push at twenty-one, and later filed a proposal it judged sound rather than fold it in. Session 3991 records the two size gates contradicting each other: squashing to clear the commit ceiling produces a commit that violates the five-file cap, which has no bypass. The label populations measure whether the ceiling stopped a bad change, which it did not. These measure what it did instead.

workLog.action: Traced where the commit ceiling actually blocks, after a reviewer showed the decision's own remediation would have retired nothing
workLog.result: Two sites, not one. pr_commit_count.py returns 0 in every case (:485-519) and says so in its own comment; the CI block is enforce_pr_validation.py:64-84, which fetches labels and fails unless commit-limit-bypass is present. The second site is local: _check_commit_limit in git_hook_policy.py:6122-6162, reached from the push-ref-policy pre-push job, counting git rev-list --count over the push range, which includes merge commits, with two reliefs the CI path has no equivalent of. Two gates, two counting rules, two relief sets, one name. ADR-098 item 1 now names both.

nextSteps: Implement ADR-098 in its stated order: fix the QA and session evidence rebind generator; remove the CI block in scripts/ci/enforce_pr_validation.py:64-84 and demote _check_commit_limit in git_hook_policy.py, which are the two commit-ceiling enforcement sites (pr_commit_count.py already returns 0 and blocking it retires nothing); demote check_atomic_commit early; demote the scope BLOCK_THRESHOLD and add process-record exclusions; then remove SKIP_SCOPE_CHECK; then update the dependent documents.

ADR-099 Phase 1 starts from the verification PR #5146 already shipped, not from issue #5099, which closed 2026-08-18. run_completion_gate.py already byte-compares each dispatched work-tree file and verifies its static import closure. The remaining work is to fail closed on a dispatched file whose closure is not statically resolvable, and to lift the same verification from P0 into a base-ref P1 job.

ADR-099 Phase 0 needs owner credentials. Containing BOT_PAT means removing the repository-level copy, restricting that environment's deployment branches to the base ref so a head workflow cannot claim it by naming the environment, determining which account owns the token, and making pull-request-time consumers base-owned; an environment stanza alone is defeated by a pull request deleting it, and an environment with required reviewers reintroduces a per-change human. ai-spec-validation.yml is the live head-defined consumer. Also set required_approving_review_count above zero and require_code_owner_review, extend CODEOWNERS to enforcement paths and to itself, make the drift check bidirectional, and baseline bypass_actors, enforcement, and the Actions default token settings. Phase 0 also has an identity prerequisite: all five CODEOWNERS entries name the owner and the loop authors as that account, so enabling require_code_owner_review would leave no eligible approver. Establish a non-author code owner or a bot-authored PR flow first.

Both ADRs reduce review requirements, so .claude/rules/governance.md MUST-1 and MUST NOT 1 apply: each needs human approval and a unanimous-consensus record before its implementation pull request merges.

Re-measure ADR-098's retirement 90 days after implementation. The counterexample search is done: ten labeled pull requests classified by hand at one 18:00Z cutoff, seven closed-unmerged and three open, and the blocking ceiling stopped nothing it did not also relieve. Survivorship is what remains, and it is narrower than an earlier revision claimed: no GitHub query recovers a deterred or squashed pull request, but eight are recorded in .agents/qa/, .agents/sessions/, and .agents/retrospective/ and are now in ADR-098. Existence is established; the size of that population is not, because those records exist only where an agent chose to write one.
